title: Against All Odds
overview: This documentary takes an inside look at the 2005-06 Dallas Mavericks season through documenting various situations with Jerry Stackhouse as he struggles with his sore right knee missing the first 27 games.This high-energy, full-access behind-the-scenes look into the world of the National Basketball Association as provided by the Dallas Mavericks' players, coaches and executives as they make their journey from training camp to the 2006 NBA championship against the Miami Heat.
